from openpyxl import load_workbook

output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/CF_12196_0_f24f778c/1_CF_12196_output.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(output_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

print("Values in C3:G6:")
for r in range(3, 7):
    print(r, [ws.cell(r, c).value for c in range(3, 8)])

print("\nConditional formatting rules:")
for cf in ws.conditional_formatting:
    print("Range:", cf.sqref)
    for rule in cf.rules:
        fill_rgb = rule.dxf.fill.fgColor.rgb if rule.dxf and rule.dxf.fill and rule.dxf.fill.fgColor else None
        print("Type:", rule.type, "Formula:", rule.formula, "Fill:", fill_rgb)

print("\nCells in C3:G6 that evaluate as >75% of weekly delivery:")
for r in range(3, 7):
    threshold = ws.cell(r, 1).value * 0.75 if isinstance(ws.cell(r, 1).value, (int, float)) else None
    hits = []
    for c in range(3, 8):
        v = ws.cell(r, c).value
        if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and threshold is not None and v > threshold:
            hits.append(ws.cell(r, c).coordinate)
    print(r, "threshold", threshold, "highlighted by rule:", hits)
